Question: What is the root of misogyny?
Answer: Few things. Many negative experiences with women Before I go deeper into this, I need to add that a lot of modern men aren’t so hostile towards women for no reason. Because let’s not sugarcoat it, this world does have at least as many deeply deeply broken and horrible women who do the worst kind of shit than it has men who are the same way. Only a fool would deny this. It‘s just that it’s not socially acceptable yet to call these narcissistic women out on their bullshit — which is why they get away with harming and abusing men without ever facing any consequences and being held accountable for it. Unfortunately, a bunch of men got burned by such women. They have either been cheated on multiple times, emotionally abused, emasculated or repeatedly used for money. And unfortunately, some of these men will fall into this dark pit where they start believing that every woman is like that. Where they can’t find a way out of all the resentment and trauma the relationships with such women caused them. Personality disorders Because narcissists usually view everyone but themselves as a supply for attention and validation, they‘re also very likely to be insanely controlling with and abusive towards women. Can’t attract nor keep a woman in his life A bunch of modern men are bitter at the way that women select and pick men because they never get selected. If left unchecked, this bitterness will eventually turn into misogyny, into a deep contempt and hatred towards all women. This is why it’s so important for us men to build our value and to become our most attractive selves. It may not seem fair that in order to build healthy relationships with women, we have to invest in ourselves and learn to be the kind of man that emotionally healthy women want. But the alternative to this is much worse.

Question: What are some ways to move on from an ex who broke up with you, ghosted you, and was not a good friend or partner?
Answer: Build the self-respect and emotional/mental stability to accept that it’s over and to not give your energy, love, commitment and attention away to a girl who repeatedly shows you that she’s for the streets and doesn’t want, love nor respect you. Like, seriously man. Have some dignity. What else needs to happen before you finally put your own well-being first? Do you seriously need her to ignore, ghost, cheat on and hurt you even more? Come on man. Now before you say 'But moving on is so hard…'. Stop being such a whiny simp. Learn to manage your emotions in a productive and self-empowering way. Crying after her way beyond the point where you’ve cried enough isn’t productive nor self-empowering. Because you know what’s even harder and what’s going to cause you even more pain than moving on and letting her go? Holding on to her and telling yourself that she was 'the one' even though she is not worth one tear and even though she has given you a lot of empirical evidence that she’s clearly not worthy of your attention, commitment and energy. She and many other women too will never respect you if you keep doing that shit. They will continue to cheat on and walk all over you if you don’t change in that regard. Your dating life will continue to suck if this doesn’t improve and you will keep attracting more cheaters. So, here’s how to respect yourself again: Set up no contact Then, never reach out to her again. Direct all the energy you would otherwise use to ruminate and cry or chase after her towards yourself and towards the intention to become a more attractive, more self-aware, more powerful and better man. Remind yourself that she has consistently proven to be a girl who adds to your pain and doesn’t contribute anything of value to your life. Your feelings will tell you otherwise but, that’s why you got to let these feelings go and release them. Rediscover your core-confidence True self-confidence comes from within and isn’t dependent on anything outside of you such as your looks, the amount of women you have sex with, situational achievements or fleeting external circumstances. Therefore, learn to emotionally and mentally build yourself up. Take action to create a better life for yourself. Celebrate your wins no matter how big or small. As a modern man, your most valuable asset in the context of dating and relationships is your attention and commitment It becomes obsolete and worthless to women if you give it away to those who don’t love nor want you. If you give it away without her having to earn and reciprocate it. That’s why your ex-girlfriend ignores you despite your best efforts. She lost attraction and just doesn’t value or respect what you have to offer because due to overextending yourself by chasing after her and begging her to come back, she started viewing you as a man with no self-respect. As a man she can cheat on, lie to, manipulate and walk all over without any consequences. This causes her to look down on you, to lose respect. And we can’t love who we don’t respect, because mutual respect is the soil upon which love grows. Therefore, start respecting yourself again. Stop tolerating dynamics of unrequited love. Stop pursuing relationships and reconciliations with emotionally unavailable ex-girlfriends. Instead, direct all your attention towards yourself. Commit to build yourself into a better man, to your goals and to your personal growth.
